Fields.Name: No Hit Distance
Fields.Description: Collision points at this distance (m) or farther count as no-hit points. Below 0: off.

Fields.Name: Include Collision Point of No Hit
Fields.Description: Accept no-hit points: rays that hit nothing (counted at the maximum ray length) or points at No Hit Distance or farther.

Fields.Name: Include Outdoor Collision Point
Fields.Description: Accept points on outdoor collision (collision not marked as indoor).

Fields.Name: Include Floor Collision Point
Fields.Description: Accept floor points (surfaces flat enough to count as floor).

Fields.Name: Evaluation Distance Calculation Type
Fields.Description: How the accepted points become the distance. 0: average of all points. 1: average of the farthest points (see Farthest Point Count and Farthest Points Ignored). Other values: no distance.

Fields.Name: Point Max Age
Fields.Description: Only points younger than this (s) are accepted. Below 0: all kept points. Points expire after the common lifetime anyway, so larger values have no effect.

Fields.Name: Farthest Point Count
Fields.Description: Calculation type 1: number of farthest points kept (at least 10).

Fields.Name: Farthest Points Ignored
Fields.Description: Calculation type 1: the farthest (this + 1) kept points are left out of the average, so 0 drops only the farthest one.
